### 🎯 Next Step Required: Enable Template Feature

**You (repository administrator) need to:**

1. Go to your repository on GitHub
2. Click **Settings** tab
3. Scroll to **Template repository** section
4. Check the box: ✅ **Template repository**
5. Save

Once enabled, a green **"Use this template"** button will appear next to the "Code" button.
